src/lib/suppliers/queries.ts is deliberately NOT wired to any route. It returns supplier identity and supplier purchase cost, and this repository has no authentication, so an exposed route would leak supplier cost publicly. Follows the existing precedent of src/lib/offers/admin-queries.ts. Wiring an operator screen requires auth first.

Production still holds zero commercial data: all 9,559 supplier_listing_prices rows have NULL purchase_price and NULL stock. The unified-search milestone needs a real priced/stocked feed from at least one lane; the ISB catalogue file does not carry price or stock columns at all.
Per-lane TTL defaults (intersprint 24/24h, deldo 24/12h, it_48h 24/8h) are engineering defaults chosen to make freshness deterministic, not business policy. Tune as real feed cadence is observed.

Staging carries deliberate synthetic fixtures: one catalogue product, two listings, two real observations and ONE fictional Deldo row (is_test_data=true, EUR 0.01, 99999 units, newest timestamp) kept as a live regression fixture for the exclusion boundary.
